newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices see slight rebound Wed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices see slight rebound Wed.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices edged up from steep declines Wednesday in NYMEX ACCESS trade, buoyed as short covering gave direction to an otherwise thin overnight market.
January crude futures settled $1.04 a barrel lower at $23.38 in daytime trade, amid a return of Iraqi crude exports and bearish inventory data.
After-hours, January crude rose gained back four cents from $23.42, as roughly 804 lots traded.
About 106 lots of January heating oil traded, with 140 exchanged in all months as the contract climbed 0.38 cents a gallon to 67.20 cents a gallon.
Front-month gasoline increased to 63.65 cents a gallon, up 0.09 cents.
